caption: 2Q21 income statement with the prior quarter's guidance printed beside the actual. Revenue beat the top of the range but 50.0% gross margin landed 1.5pp below it, the only margin miss in the set.
2Q21 node mix (7nm 31%, 5nm 18%, 49% advanced) and the 7nm-and-below revenue chart running back to 3Q18, the earliest bar in the stitched 32-quarter leading-edge series.
2Q21 platform mix, the 'before' picture: Smartphone 42% was larger than HPC 39%, the reverse of today's 22% and 66%.
2Q21 balance sheet: asset productivity 0.9x, inventory 85 days, A/R 42 days, net PP&E 55.7% of assets. The pre-AI baseline for the capital-intensity series.
2Q21 recent events. The annual Technology Symposium cadence starts here, and the NXP FinFET design win is the only customer named in any of the six decks.
2Q23 income statement, the downturn quarter. Revenue declined 10.0% YoY and shipments 23.2%, yet gross margin still beat the top of guidance by 0.1pp and operating margin by 0.5pp.
2Q23 node mix and the 7nm-and-below chart for 1Q21-2Q23. 5nm passes 7nm (30% vs 23%) and the leading-edge total holds through the downcycle.

2Q23 platform growth. HPC declined only 5% QoQ against Smartphone -9% and IoT -11%, so HPC was already the most defensive platform three years before it became the majority of revenue. The text extraction mis-orders these bars; read the image.
2Q23 cash flows. Free cash flow went negative at -NT$83.28bn because capex ran NT$250.53bn against NT$167.25bn of operating cash. The downcycle stress case.
2Q23 recent events. The Advanced Backend Fab 6 / 3DFabric opening is the single mention of advanced packaging anywhere in the six decks.

2Q25 income statement. Revenue beat the top of guidance by 3.0% and operating margin by 0.6pp even though the NT dollar came in 4.5% stronger than the guidance assumption, worth roughly 1.4pp of margin headwind.
2Q25 node mix with 3nm added at 24%. Advanced nodes reach 74% of wafer revenue, up from 49% in 2Q21.
2Q25 platform mix and growth. HPC is 60% of revenue growing 14% QoQ while Automotive is flat at 0%.
2Q25 balance sheet. Asset productivity recovers to 1.1x and A/R days hit a low of 23, the cleanest working-capital quarter in the set.
2Q25 cash flows. NT$497.07bn operating cash against NT$297.22bn capex leaves NT$199.85bn of free cash flow, covering the dividend 1.7x.
3Q25 guidance. This is the last standalone guidance slide TSMC published; the Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 decks drop it while the 6-K keeps guiding.
2Q25 recent events dating the A14 debut to the 2025 North America Technology Symposium (2025-04-24), the roadmap claim the company map flags as a marketing ceiling.

4Q25 income statement, the largest beat in the set. Gross margin came in 1.3pp above the top of guidance and operating margin 3.0pp above, so the operating-margin beat was more than double the gross-margin beat.
4Q25 node mix at 77% advanced, plus the 7nm-and-below chart for 1Q23-4Q25 showing 7nm holding a flat NT$100-120bn band while 5nm and 3nm stack on top.
FY2025 versus FY2024 node mix side by side: 3nm 18% to 24%, 7nm 17% to 14%, advanced 69% to 74%. The only annual node comparison presented on one slide.
4Q25 platform mix and growth. The seasonal reversal shows HPC at +4% QoQ against Smartphone +11%, pushing HPC's share from 60% down to 55%.
FY2025 platform growth for all six platforms: HPC +48%, Smartphone +11%, IoT +15%, Automotive +34%, DCE +0%, Others +34%. The 20-F names only the first two.
FY2025 financial highlights on one page: revenue +31.6%, gross margin 59.9%, capex NT$1,272.41bn, free cash flow NT$1,002.57bn, dividends NT$466.78bn, ROE 35.4%.

1Q26 platform growth, the panel the text extractor drops entirely. Automotive -7% QoQ, Smartphone -11%, HPC +20%. Without it the 2Q26 automotive turn looks like a flat line ticking up rather than a reversal.

2Q26 income statement. Revenue grew 36.0% YoY while cost of revenue grew only 6.1% and opex 17.1%, implying roughly 90% incremental operating margin. Non-operating items jumped to NT$95.83bn, inflating EPS and ROE.

2Q26 node mix with 2nm appearing at 3%, and the four-band 7nm-and-below chart reaching about NT$825bn. 7nm still holds about NT$120bn after 24 quarters, the clearest evidence that nodes stack rather than rotate.
2Q26 platform mix and growth. HPC at 66% grew 20% QoQ while Smartphone declined 4% for a second straight quarter and Automotive inflected +15%.
2Q26 balance sheet. Inventory 87 days and A/R 29 days build on the N2 ramp, while long-term debt declined to NT$864.27bn and liabilities/assets to 30.9%: record capex funded without leverage.
2Q26 cash flows. Record NT$783.36bn operating cash, yet free cash flow declined 17.5% QoQ because capex jumped to NT$496.00bn (US$15.70bn), thinning dividend cover to 1.85x.
2Q26 recent events. The Vanguard 8.1% disposal lands in the same quarter non-operating items tripled, Sony extends into next-generation image sensors, and A13 debuts at the 2026 symposium.
